subject: Gen7 donor audit: adapt duo-fold-live animation lab features without replacing Gen7 authority core
body: Primary audited joeconsorti/duo-fold-live main 8ca4371bf4c83ea6c840a2d500325e55635245be. Treat it as a donor/reference implementation, not a replacement base. Gen7 will adopt/adapt selectable animation styles, independent fold/unfold direction policy, separate cover/inner stretch/compression/easing, blur/glass/seam/reflection tuning, quality/AA controls, explicit 60/120 diagnostic target selection, preview-release causal concepts, and endpoint diagnostics. Do not import donor angle/direction semantics, black fade as continuity solution, whole direct/concurrent handoff architecture, or experimental display power override as production authority. Security precedence remains PRIVATE_FROST > VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH > PUBLIC_GLASS. Creator video, when supplied, is explanatory evidence only and must be checked against source/field evidence.
